comparator.name: Sociology
comparator.academicYear: Current published UvA bachelor curriculum, checked 2026-09-27
comparator.sourceNotes: The official programme is 180 EC over three years. Year 1 is a fixed 60-EC foundation in sociological theory, institutions, academic craft, philosophy of social science, qualitative and quantitative methodology, statistics and an Amsterdam research project. Year 2 totals 60 EC across four theory/method components and six substantive domains: education and work; intersectionality; migration and citizenship; urban places; health and society; and globalising cultures. Year 3 contains 30 EC genuine free choice, 6 EC Mixed Methods, 6 EC Sociology of Public Policy and an 18-EC Bachelor Research Project culminating in a thesis. The English and bilingual tracks have the same curriculum.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest programme uses the complete available UCR sociology sequence and a strong mixed-method social-research spine. The institution/policy and migration/race/global-society directions are independently supported by generator-eligible programme interests and the official curriculum, produce substantively different course choices, and pass feasibility and pairwise distinctness. Production therefore stops at the three-alternative maximum.

notes.text: UvA Sociology provides four dedicated theory courses, an integrated quantitative–qualitative methods sequence, six specialist sociological domains and an 18-EC bachelor research project. UCR offers a coherent sociology core and strong related study in politics, law, history, psychology, economics, media and research methods, but it does not reproduce the same continuous specialist sociology sequence. The UCR alternatives therefore preserve this difference in disciplinary depth.
